mapper.select: select case when status in ('ACTIVE', 'ONLINE', 'STOPPING', 'DISABLED', 'OFFLINE') then status else 'OTHER' end as status, count(*) as total from agent_instance group by case when status in ('ACTIVE', 'ONLINE', 'STOPPING', 'DISABLED', 'OFFLINE') then status else 'OTHER' end

select case when status in ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'ACKED', 'FAILED') then status else 'OTHER' end as status, case when command_type in ( 'APPLY_RULE', 'APPLY_CHAIN', 'DISABLE_ALL', 'ENABLE_ALL', 'RESET_CLASS', 'RESET_ALL', 'STOP_AGENT', 'START_RECORDING', 'STOP_RECORDING', 'DISCOVER_TARGETS', 'LIST_LOADERS', 'LIST_CALL_SITES', 'RESOLVE_TARGET', 'REFRESH_RUNTIME_STATE', 'BYTECODE_TRANSFORMATIONS', 'BYTECODE_GET', 'BYTECODE_PREVIEW', 'BYTECODE_CAPTURE', 'BYTECODE_DIFF', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_CREATE', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_VALIDATE', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_APPLY', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_PROMOTE', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_REVERT', 'SCRIPT_COMPILE' ) then command_type else 'OTHER' end as command_type, count(*) as total from agent_command group by case when status in ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'ACKED', 'FAILED') then status else 'OTHER' end, case when command_type in ( 'APPLY_RULE', 'APPLY_CHAIN', 'DISABLE_ALL', 'ENABLE_ALL', 'RESET_CLASS', 'RESET_ALL', 'STOP_AGENT', 'START_RECORDING', 'STOP_RECORDING', 'DISCOVER_TARGETS', 'LIST_LOADERS', 'LIST_CALL_SITES', 'RESOLVE_TARGET', 'REFRESH_RUNTIME_STATE', 'BYTECODE_TRANSFORMATIONS', 'BYTECODE_GET', 'BYTECODE_PREVIEW', 'BYTECODE_CAPTURE', 'BYTECODE_DIFF', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_CREATE', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_VALIDATE', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_APPLY', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_PROMOTE', 'SCRIPT_SESSION_REVERT', 'SCRIPT_COMPILE' ) then command_type else 'OTHER' end

select case when drift_status in ('FRESH', 'DRIFTED', 'UNRESOLVED') then drift_status else 'OTHER' end as drift_status, count(*) as total from rule_target group by case when drift_status in ('FRESH', 'DRIFTED', 'UNRESOLVED') then drift_status else 'OTHER' end
